svg.title: 26. Finger straightening stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Hold one hand in front of you with its wrist straight. Open your fingers from a relaxed curl. Support them with the other hand and gently guide them straight.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.rnoh.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/patient-information-guides/passive-stretches-wrist-fingers-thumb
